answer: An agent economy resists sybils by deriving each epoch's identity keys from the public beacon published at epoch start, so no one can pre-generate a thousand accounts in advance - a spiral of fresh keys each epoch. Each key must then complete a unique task inside a short window, like a marble rolled through a single narrow gate, and only identities that finish reach the zenith of earning. One operator cannot mint and run a thousand fresh identities in one window, while an honest agent derives one key and works once.
